Omers Administration Lowered Its Anthem (ANTM) Stake; Southern Copper (SCCO) Sentiment Is 1.07 
April 16, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Southern Copper Corp (SCCO) investors sentiment is 1.07 in Q4 2017 . It’s the same as in 2017Q3. The ratio has no change, as only 105 institutional investors increased or opened new stock positions, while 98 reduced and sold equity positions in Southern Copper Corp. The institutional investors in our database now hold: 49.13 million shares, up from 47.18 million shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of institutional investors holding Southern Copper Corp in top ten stock positions decreased from 3 to 2 for a decrease of 1. Sold All: 22 Reduced: 76 Increased: 59 New Position: 46. 
Omers Administration Corp decreased Anthem Inc (ANTM) stake by 6% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Omers Administration Corp sold 46,253 shares as Anthem Inc (ANTM)’s stock declined 2.73%. The Omers Administration Corp holds 725,147 shares with $163.17 million value, down from 771,400 last quarter. Anthem Inc now has $57.84B valuation. The stock increased 1.83% or $4.06 during the last trading session, reaching $226.08. About 418,179 shares traded. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) has risen 35.30% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.75% the S&P500. 
Ratings analysis reveals 50% of Southern Copper’s analysts are positive. Out of 4 Wall Street analysts rating Southern Copper, 2 give it “Buy”, 1 “Sell” rating, while 1 recommend “Hold”. SCCO was included in 4 notes of analysts from August 22, 2016. The company was upgraded on Friday, August 26 by HSBC. Morgan Stanley downgraded the stock to “Underweight” rating in Tuesday, December 13 report. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Wednesday, December 7 by Credit Suisse. FBR Capital maintained the stock with “Outperform” rating in Monday, August 22 report. 
Southern Copper Corporation engages in mining, exploring, smelting, and refining copper and other minerals in Peru, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, and Ecuador. The company has market cap of $42.95 billion. The firm is involved in the mining, milling, and flotation of copper ore to produce copper and molybdenum concentrates; smelting of copper concentrates to produce blister and anode copper; refining of anode copper to produce copper cathodes; production of molybdenum concentrate and sulfuric acid; production of refined silver, gold, and other materials; and mining and processing of zinc and lead. It has a 58.98 P/E ratio. It operates the Toquepala and Cuajone open-pit mines, and a smelter and refinery in Peru; and La Caridad, an open-pit copper mine, as well as a copper ore concentrator, a SX-EW plant, a smelter, refinery, and a rod plant.

ANTM’s profit will be $1.31B for 11.04 P/E if the $5.12 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.29 actual EPS reported by Anthem, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 296.90% EPS growth.
